_comment: TEMPLATE — documents intended multi-region setup; provisioning three
separate Vercel projects (one per region) is done by ops in the Vercel
dashboard/CLI, not by this file alone. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
Ethiopia (Phase 2):  Vercel project 'hurbad-ecommerce-et', region af-south-1 (S. Africa)
Each project gets its own env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_REGION, DATABASE_URL,
DATABASE_READ_REPLICA_URL, payment gateway keys, currency, tax rate)
set via `vercel env add` or the dashboard — see .env.production.{ke,et,so}
for the full variable list per region.
